gate.rationale: YOWOFormer-B parity level. v1 dense owner caps at 89.23 with VideoMAE-Base; reproduced YOWOFormer-L reaches 92.48 with VideoMAE-Large.

notes: V2-WS1.1 trained cleanly for ten epochs (13.02 -> 7.58) before a single non-finite forward poisoned the BatchNorm running statistics. bfloat16 carries the float32 exponent range, so that overflow class is removed; the new abort guard stops a dead run within 25 steps instead of 8 epochs.
one_variable: AMP autocast dtype float16 -> bfloat16. Learning rate, schedule, batch, seed and architecture are unchanged from V2-WS1.1.
parent: scratch (fresh lineage; pretrained VideoMAE-L, frozen native (2+1)D motion from phase3a_150ep, frozen YOLO11-L keyframe)
purpose: Rerun of V2-WS1.1 after it diverged to NaN in epoch 10 under float16 autocast. Identical in every respect except the AMP dtype, so the VideoMAE-Large question is answered without a second confound.
